title: Controller device loses Wi-Fi connection after returning to network mode from cloud
description: The controller device disconnects from Wi-Fi upon switching from cloud mode back to network mode within the Luxor application.
steps: Ensure the controller device is connected to Wi-Fi and in 'network mode' within the Luxor app.
Navigate to the cloud mode option within the Luxor app.
Return the controller device to 'network mode' using the Luxor app.
Observe the controller device's Wi-Fi connection status.
actual: The controller device loses its Wi-Fi connection after the mode switch.
expected: The controller device should maintain its Wi-Fi connection when switching between cloud and network modes.
